[SWS_DM_00926] Event memory overflow notifier on clear
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04093
⌈
If an
overflow
has occurred, as specified in [SWS_DM_00923]), for a particular
event memory
, the DM shall, after the next execution of clear all DTCs for that par-
ticular
event memory
, call the corresponding overflow notification function for that
event memory
, which was registered via the function
ara::diag::DTCInfor-
mation::SetEventMemoryOverflowNotifier
for this
event memory
instance,
with the parameter value set to
false
.
⌋
